name: Breadcrumb / Repository Path
description: Repository Path product scenario for the Breadcrumb component.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Ordered locations from root to current; the last kept item is the current page. Groups and separators are dropped with a report.

controls.name: separator
controls.description: Decorative separator. '/' uses the slash icon; empty content removes the separator.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around inline items and the overflow trigger.

controls.name: maxItems
controls.description: Visible positions including the overflow button, an integer from 3; null shows every item.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names of the component's own controls: `more` names the overflow button and its dialog.
